brief_summary: Cross-section of the light path from the PCB-mounted per-key RGB LED, up through a Gateron G Pro 3.0 Yellow switch's frosted light-guide top housing, into the underside of a pale GMK CYL Ramune keycap, continuing sideways as diffusion through the Ikki68 Aurora's translucent polycarbonate case wall. Illustrates the article's three-stage light-chain argument.
